content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I have just finished my first project on [product_name] and want to transfer it to a new [product_name] [article_no]. I connected the FTP cable, but Windows does not detect the [product_name]. A new LAN connection appears, but shows 'No network access.' Despite this, I tried entering the IP address in [product_name] to transfer the program, but it did not work. Can someone provide a complete specification for configuring network settings on Windows 7 64-bit so I can test my project live?

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered difficulty transferring a project from [product_name] to a [product_name] device using an FTP cable. Windows 7 64-bit did not detect the hardware and displayed network connection issues. Manual IP entry in the transfer application did not resolve the problem. The main challenge involves network configuration and device detection between the software and hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to connect and communicate smoothly between their software and hardware on Windows 7 64-bit, with clear network setup guidance to enable successful program transfers.
